entries.label: s2_sub_009_select_01
entries.text: Mela? Is that you?!

entries.label: s2_sub_009_select_02
entries.text: Um, have we met?!

entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_03
entries.text: Seriously? You have eyes, don’t you? Obviously\nit’s Mela you’re talkin’ to![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_04
entries.text: Oh, right. I guess I’m not decked out in my usual\ngear today.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_05
entries.text: Eri made a big fuss about wearin’ our uniforms\nfor this study-group thing.\c\nSo yeah, it’s not like I had much of a choice.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_06
entries.text: But what’re you doin’ here anyway?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_select_03
entries.text: I’ve been looking for you

entries.label: s2_sub_009_select_04
entries.text: I came to raid your base

entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_07
entries.text: Wow, what’s the occasion? You itchin’ for another\nshowdown or somethin’?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_08
entries.text: A raid? Sorry, pal. I’m not in the mood for a\nnostalgia trip right now.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_09
entries.text: ...Oh. OK. You came up here to bring me back to\nthe classroom, huh?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_10
entries.text: Guess time got away from me while I was\nadmirin’ the veggies.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_11
entries.text: Might as well get goin’, then.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_12
entries.text: ’Sup, amigos![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_01
entries.text: Mellie! Welcome back![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_02
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]And [VAR 0x0100(0000)]—thanks so much
for
finding
her.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_fairy_01
entries.text: So? Where were you lazing around this time?[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_13
entries.text: Eh, you know... Here ’n’ there.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_doku_01
entries.text: Lady Mela? Is something amiss?[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_aku_01
entries.text: Nahhh, we’re all good, right? The dream study\nteam’s all here—that’s what counts![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_aku_02
entries.text: Time’s a-wastin’, so I say let’s hit the books![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_aku_03
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Take it away, Professor
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]!
These
three
are
countin’
on ya![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_aku_npc
entries.text: Leave the music to me! I’ll keep a steady stream\nof lo-fi chill beats playin’ for ya.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_npc
entries.text: I hope everyone tries their best![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_01
entries.text: Guh, how am I supposed to know this? I don’t\nget it...[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_select_01
entries.text: See how it’s going

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_select_02
entries.text: Back off for now

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_02
entries.text: Don’t think I didn’t see you and your smug face\nhovering there. You’ve got some nerve.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_20
entries.text: You realize I’m a second-year student, right?\nI’m an entire year ABOVE you.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_03
entries.text:
...Hmph. Eri says we need to let you help, so fine!
You can try to tutor me or whatever.\c
But I’ll be shocked if you can get this literature
stuff to sink in.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_04
entries.text: I mean, how am I supposed to know how some\nmade-up characters in a story are feeling?![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_05
entries.text:
See, the protagonist in this book is the mom in a
Maushold family—her name’s Mama Maushold.\c
We’re supposed to analyze why she calls Papa
Maushold “terrible” in this passage.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_book_01
entries.text:
Mama Maushold’s eyes glittered with tears.
It was clear from the letter Papa Maushold
had left: she would never get to see him again.
“Toying with my feelings right to the end...
You really are a [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]terrible [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]thing.”

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_select_01
entries.text: She must truly think he’s terrible

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_select_02
entries.text: She must actually love him a lot

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_select_03
entries.text: We can’t know what’s in her heart

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_06
entries.text: Huh. Maybe you’re not half bad at tutoring after\nall! The answer was staring me right in the face!\r\nWhy did I even bother overthinking this?[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_aku_01
entries.text: OK, no, hold up! Why would they ask you to\nanalyze this if the answer’s written right there?\c\nI just...feel like that’s not the right call...[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_07
entries.text: Hey, Giacomo’s calling you out! Are you sure\nyou really know your stuff?![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_08
entries.text: I’m starting to think you’re as bad as I am at\nunderstanding how people feel...[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_09
entries.text: You know what? I’ve seen all I needed to see.\c\nI think I’ll be better off studying by myself, so\nfeel free to toddle on home, “Professor.”[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_10
entries.text: HUH?! So she calls him terrible, but she actually\nloves him? Why doesn’t she just say that, then?\r\nThere’s no way that’s the right answer![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_aku_02
entries.text: You sure about that, my man? I’d have thought\nyou of all people would relate![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_11
entries.text: What’s that supposed to mean?[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_aku_03
entries.text:
Only that you do exactly the same thing with
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\c
You’re always snappin’ at h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer and bein’ difficult,
but you actually respect h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer a ton, don’tcha?[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_12
entries.text: WHAT?! You must be JOKING! There’s no\nuniverse in which I respect this oaf even a little!\r\nNuh-uh, no way, NOPE![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_14
entries.text: Fine, OK. I guess people are tempted to say\nthe opposite of what they mean sometimes.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_15
entries.text: Hmph. This question makes more sense to me\nnow. But just a tiny bit!\c\nThanks for not being entirely useless.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_16
entries.text:
Huh. Didn’t expect such an astute answer from
the likes of you!\c
It’s so true that we just don’t know what goes on
in other people’s heads. That’s gotta be it.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_aku_04
entries.text: OK, no. Hold up! There’s no way the correct\nanswer is somethin’ as lazy as that.\c\nI just...feel like you should rethink this one...[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_17
entries.text: Hey, Giacomo’s calling you out! Are you sure\nyou really know your stuff?![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_18
entries.text: I’m starting to think you’re as bad as I am at\nunderstanding how people feel...[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_19
entries.text: You know what? I’ve seen all I needed to see.\c\nI think I’ll be better off studying by myself, so\nfeel free to toddle on home, “Professor.”[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_npc
entries.text:
Okaaay, moving on to the next one...\c
“A tale of three Spidops whose brotherly bonds
are even more tangled than the webs they
weave.” Huh?! ANOTHER family sob story?[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_01
entries.text: What I know...is that I know naught. I have\nfathom’d the depths of mine own ignorance...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_02
entries.text: Ah, noble sensei. Comest thou to proffer me a\nhelping hand?[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_03
entries.text: My deepest thanks...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_04
entries.text: Mathematics is the scourge of my existence—in\nparticular, arithmetic! ’Tis an unsolvable mystery.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_05
entries.text: But since my true calling lies in garment design,\nI feel I need not concern myself with numbers.\r\nThey have naught to do with fashion, after all![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_select_01
entries.text: Yeah, I guess they don’t

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_select_02
entries.text: No, you’ll need numbers

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_06
entries.text: Aha! So our views are in alignment.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_07
entries.text: Then I shan’t waste a moment more on arithmetic.\nThe ninja arts are where my focus should lie![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_select_03
entries.text: That’s right!

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_select_04
entries.text: Hold on a sec

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_08
entries.text: Hrmmm... Skill in mathematics will still be of\nservice to me, you say? I do not quite follow...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_kakutou_01
entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I think I know what [VAR 0x0100(0000)] is\ngetting at.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_kakutou_02
entries.text: It’s like with our Team Star outfits, remember?\nWe ended up spending a lot of money on them.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_09
entries.text: As indeed we should! One must not shy from\nexpense when creating objects of great quality.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_kakutou_03
entries.text:
But we had reams of fabric left over after the
outfits were made.\c
Don’t you think we could have saved more
money there?[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_10
entries.text: I...I cannot deny it. ’Tis a fair point.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_11
entries.text:
Now that I think of it, the garments’ dimensions
and the cost of materials demand calculation.\c
And if selling one’s creations, profit margins, too,
come into play...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_12
entries.text: A designer who pays heed to such figures and\nsums would surely prove the superior artisan![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_13
entries.text: ’Twould seem my thinking was naive... I had\nturn’d mine eyes from the inconvenient truth.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_14
entries.text: Splendid! I shall fetch my shuriken forthwith and\nretire outdoors for target practice![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_kakutou_04
entries.text: Don’t even think about it, Atticus! You can’t just\nabandon an entire subject![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_15
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]B-but Lady Eri! [VAR 0x0100(0000)] hath
already
approv’d
my
training
in
the
ninja arts...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_kakutou_05
entries.text:
Hey, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...\c
I don’t mean to criticize, but could you try not to
encourage these three to neglect their studies?
It’s really not in their best interest...[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_16
entries.text: O, Lady Eri, the melancholy upon thy face cuts\nme to the core. Perhaps I judg’d poorly...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_17
entries.text: Very well. I will return to the joyless embrace of\narithmetic, no matter my wishes to the contrary...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_18
entries.text: Hrm? Thou meanst to say my desir’d course of\naction would be one step too far?[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_19
entries.text: Curse thee, arithmetic—my foul nemesis. Yet\nagain you thwart my pursuit of joy...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_kakutou_06
entries.text: Atticus! You’re making this into a bigger issue\nthan it needs to be.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_kakutou_07
entries.text: We all have things we’re bad at, and life will\nalways throw challenges our way.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_kakutou_08
entries.text:
But, uh...that doesn’t mean we should just quit!\c
For me, there’s nothing more inspiring than
someone who tackles their problems head-on
and finds a way through![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_20
entries.text: Lady Eri...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_21
entries.text: That decides it! My heart is changed and my\nmind made up. From now on...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_22
entries.text: I will devote myself to the study of mathematics!\nHI-YAAAAAAAAAH!!![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_npc
entries.text: Curse thee, fractional division... Why must I\ninvert the numerator and denominator? Why?![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_kakutou_09
entries.text:
Sorry I kinda butted in on your tutoring just now,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\c
I’m glad it all worked out though. Thanks to you,
Atticus seems really inspired to study![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_kakutou_10
entries.text: He’s the type that gets totally absorbed once\nhe’s fired up, so I’m sure he’ll be just fine![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_kakutou_11
entries.text: Well, it looks like Atticus is a bit more motivated\nto study than before...[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_kakutou_12
entries.text: But he seems so sad, it doesn’t exactly fill me\nwith confidence that he’ll do well on his tests.\r\nThat’s a real shame...[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_01
entries.text: Man, this is hard...[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_02
entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Huh? What’re you lookin’ at,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?\c\n...Oh yeah. You’re our tutor now, aren’tcha?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_03
entries.text:
All right, then. I was just doin’ some practice
questions.\c
Here, lemme know if you think this one’s true
or false.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_04
entries.text: “You can get new Pokémon only by catching\nthem yourself or trading with other Trainers.”[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_select_01
entries.text: That’s true

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_select_02
entries.text: That’s false

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_05
entries.text:
Huh?! Did you forget about Eggs? That’s another
way you can get new Pokémon, ain’t it?\c
Tch. Don’t go counting out Eggs before they’ve
even hatched. That’s just rude.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_06
entries.text: Yeah, that’s what I thought, too. Can’t go\nforgettin’ about Pokémon you hatch from Eggs.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_08
entries.text: “What is the name of the gemstone that glows\nover a Pokémon’s head when it Terastallizes?”[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_select_03
entries.text: Tera Jewel

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_select_04
entries.text: Tera Rock

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_select_05
entries.text: Tera Stone

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_09
entries.text: Yeah, that sounds about right!\c\nGuess it makes sense you know about all this,\nseein’ as you have your own Tera Orb.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_10
entries.text: Tera Rock? You sure about that? I don’t recall\nthat thing havin’ such a stupid-soundin’ name...\r\nNope, not ringin’ any bells.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_11
entries.text: Tera Stone? That sounds like it could be it...\nBut nah, it’s not actually ringin’ any bells.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_12
entries.text:
Either way, Terastallizing is pretty awesome,
don’tcha think?\c
Only “outstanding” students get to have a
Tera Orb all for themselves, though...[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_14
entries.text: This has zilch to do with tests, but, uh...I wanna\nask you somethin’.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_15
entries.text: I dunno how to put it though... It’s a tricky one.\nYou gotta promise not to laugh, OK?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_16
entries.text: So, uh... How important do you think dreams are?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_select_06
entries.text: Like, when we sleep?

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_select_07
entries.text: Like, our future goals?

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_select_08
entries.text: HAHAHAHAHAHA!!!

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_17
entries.text: No! Obviously not that kinda dream! I’m talkin’\nabout goals! What we wanna do with our lives![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_18
entries.text: Exactly! I’m talkin’ about the future! What we\nwanna be when we’re older—that kinda stuff![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_19
entries.text: HEY! I told you not to laugh!!!\c\nHope it was worth it, ’cause that’s the last time\nI ever ask you about anythin’![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_20
entries.text: I’ve got no idea about all that right now...[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_21
entries.text: Meanwhile, most of Team Star seem like they’ve\ngot it figured out. They’ve got proper dreams.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_22
entries.text: Even the veggies in the schoolyard are doin’\ntheir best to grow, y’know?\c\nI wish I had their kinda direction...[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_23
entries.text: I mean, what’ll happen if I never figure it out?\nWhat if I never find a dream to chase?\r\nHonestly, I get scared just thinkin’ about it.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_select_09
entries.text: You’ll find a dream someday!

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_select_10
entries.text: You have your art, don’t you?

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_24
entries.text: You’re a hopeless optimist, you know that?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_25
entries.text: But I guess...yeah. Panicking about it won’t help.\nThanks for the valuable lesson, teach.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_26
entries.text: Huh? How’d you know I joined the art club?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_27
entries.text: Well, whatever, that’s just a hobby anyway.\nNot like I’m gonna do art to earn a livin’...[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_28
entries.text: Wait. Now I think about it, Mr. Dragonbrows\ndoes art for HIS job.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_29
entries.text: He always looks like he’s havin’ a great time at\nschool—it’s like he’s not workin’ at all![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_30
entries.text: If I could do somethin’ like that... If I could paint\nfor a livin’...that’d be crazy fun![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_31
entries.text: Do you think that could be it? Is it really OK to\ncall that my dream?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_select_11
entries.text: For sure!

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_select_12
entries.text: Not really

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_32
entries.text: Oh, come on! You’re supposed to say “for sure”\nto a question like that![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_33
entries.text: You’re right—that’s gotta be it! That’s my dream![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_34
entries.text: Man...I feel like a whole new person! Thanks,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_35
entries.text: Tch. I’ve heard enough. Lemme get back to\nstudyin’ already, would ya?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_36
entries.text: I didn’t bust my butt comin’ back to school just\nto get kicked out.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_system_01
entries.text: You continued to tutor Team Star for a while...

entries.label: s2_sub_009_aku_04
entries.text: All right, gang, I’d say it’s about time we cue the\noutro and wrap up today’s study sesh![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_03
entries.text: Yes, great effort all around! Does everyone feel\nlike they made progress today?[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_fairy_02
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Totally! I sped through my practice questions
like a CHAMP!\c
I guess [VAR 0x0100(0000)] wasn’t the
world’s
worst
tutor.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_fairy_03
entries.text: I guess I did OK. Sure feels like we didn’t need\na tutor, though.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_doku_02
entries.text:
Well, I learn’d that even arithmetic can be
enthralling when engaged with in earnest!\c
Thanks to our esteem’d tutor, I feel enliven’d
as a Revavroom drench’d in poison![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_doku_03
entries.text: Were a thousand lifetimes to pass afore I next\nencounter arithmetic, ’twould still be too soon...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_14
entries.text: I feel like someone’s used Defog on me, man.\c\nI’m seein’ everythin’ so clearly, the knowledge\nis just pourin’ itself into my brain![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_15
entries.text: I dunno... I managed to cram the makeup test\ntopics into my brain, but that’s about it.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_04
entries.text: Oh, that’s brilliant, everyone! Well done! It\nsounds like this was our best session yet![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_05
entries.text: It must’ve been thanks to your expert tutoring![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_06
entries.text: Hm, it looks like we had some mixed results. But\nwe should be OK for the makeup tests, at least![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_07
entries.text: So no one made much headway, huh? Oh dear...\nThat doesn’t bode well for your tests...[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_08
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)], it really was
kind
of
you
to
help
us out.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_09
entries.text: We prepared a little thank-you gift from all of\nus, so here you go![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_system_02
entries.text:
You also obtained the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Modified Uniform A[VAR 0xFF00(0000)],
[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Modified Uniform B[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Team Star Sunglasses[VAR 0xFF00(0000)],
[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Team Star Gloves[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Team Star Heels[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Team Star[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]
[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Helmet[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], and [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Team Star Case[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!

entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_14
entries.text: And let’s do Team Star’s pose together, too!\nHere, I’ll teach you how to do it.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_system_03
entries.text: You learned the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Hasta la Vistar ☆ emote[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] from Eri!

entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_01
entries.text: Wha—? Guys! What are you all doing here?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_fairy_04
entries.text: Yeesh. Busted.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_02
entries.text: Um... I was just walking down the hall and saw\nyou all in here...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_03
entries.text: B-but that’s fine! No one asked me to join, so I\nshould just leave, shouldn’t I?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_04
entries.text: S-sorry about that. See you later![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_doku_04
entries.text: Lady Penny, wait![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_10
entries.text: It’s not what you think, Penny! Hear us out![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_aku_06
entries.text: So what happened was...[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_05
entries.text: Phew... I thought you’d all decided not to talk to\nme anymore.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_11
entries.text: We would never![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_12
entries.text: That’s what it must’ve looked like though, huh.\nSorry we made you worry.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_16
entries.text: We just didn’t wanna drag you into another one\nof our messes... Our bad, Penny.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_06
entries.text: Well, apology NOT accepted![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_fairy_05
entries.text: ...Wait, for real?[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_07
entries.text: Why do YOU guys get to decide that I’d just be\nweighed down by your problems?![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_08
entries.text: I...I’m your friend, right?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_09
entries.text: So...you should come bother me more. Lean on\nme! That’s what’d actually make me happy...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_doku_05
entries.text: O, Lady Penny...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_10
entries.text: A-and if things get really bad, I can just hack into\nthe school system and fix your grades anyway![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_13
entries.text: What?! That’s a terrible idea![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_aku_07
entries.text: Yeah, isn’t that takin’ it a bit far?[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_11
entries.text: Ah... Sorry. That was a joke![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_12
entries.text: I was trying to lighten things up in here, but I\nguess that was pretty out of character...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_17
entries.text: Glad to hear it! If you were serious, I would’ve\nhad to pummel some sense into ya![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_13
entries.text: B-but about before! I’m actually a pretty good\ntutor, you know.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_14
entries.text: So feel free to ask me for help with studying\nand stuff anytime![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_doku_06
entries.text: Lady Penny, we are honor’d by thy generosity.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_fairy_06
entries.text: Ugh! Does that mean we gotta get lectured by\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)] AND Penny now?[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_fairy_07
entries.text: Well...I guess there are worse things.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_aku_08
entries.text: Haha! Careful, my man—that was dangerously\nclose to a straight-up compliment![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_aku_09
entries.text: You can just come right out and say you like the\nidea. We all know you’re thinkin’ it![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_doku_07
entries.text: Indeed! I need not even use my ninja senses,\nso childishly apparent are thy true feelings![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_fairy_08
entries.text: WHAT?! As if you know what’s in my head![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_fairy_09
entries.text: You guys haven’t got the first clue about me![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_fairy_10
entries.text: Try getting to know me better before spouting\nnonsense, huh?! You’re! All! The! WORST!!![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_18
entries.text: Pff. H-hey guys? I...I think we broke Ortega![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: s2_sub_009_all_01
entries.text: Ahahahahahahahahaha!
